types.wptheme: custom WordPress theme folder (themes in the WordPress.org directory and known commercial themes excluded)
types.skeleton: identical HTML skeleton of the homepage (tag and class names, no text; SHA-256, first 16 hex)
types.cert: one TLS certificate names both domains
types.ns: name servers run on another tracked developer domain
types.ip: the same server IP address with a reverse name that is not a hosting platform (Cloudflare, cloud, CDN and shared hosting excluded)

rule: Only identifiers carried by two or more different developers. Analytics and chat ids shared by more than 8 developers, and templates, certificates, name servers or IPs shared by more than 4, are dropped as platforms or shared hosting.
caveat: A shared id usually means the same marketing agency, web studio or hosting account, not the same owner. It is a public fact to ask about, not a finding.
method: Read once per day per domain from the public homepage source (robots.txt respected), its DNS records (Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS) and the TLS certificate it presents. No personal data, no page text.
